'''Like the Wind''' (Korean: '''바람처럼''' ''Baramcheoreom'') is the ending theme for the 2012 Korean redubbing of ''[[M01|Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back]]''. It is performed by Do Yunsuk. It was also used as an insert song for the Korean dub of [[SM021]].
